title: Import one standalone AP214 STEP solid as a new native part

params.name: source
params.description: A plain AP214 STEP file no larger than 64 MiB, containing one advanced BREP solid with planar/cylindrical faces and line/circle geometry. No assembly or external references. SolidWorks must have no open documents.

params.name: output
params.description: An existing output folder on the SW-Agent backup volume, disjoint from the STEP input and private data.

params.name: fileName
params.description: One new filename with a native part extension. Existing destinations are refused.
